data.description:
## Context

F28A and F45 are approved with the operator correction. GitHub Actions is active and supplies Verified. GitHub Issues is disabled, with integration planned. Current runbooks also describe inactive Verified enforcement, obsolete vote carry, and prior submit behavior.

## Plan

- State the current GitHub Actions and GitHub Issues posture.
- Reference the planned Issues integration without presenting it as available.
- Document the active two-vote gate, current vote carry and reset behavior, and Rebase If Necessary.
- Preserve Gerrit-only merging and rollback procedures.
- Make no service setting changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The mirror runbook states that GitHub Actions remains enabled and supplies Verified.
- [ ] The mirror runbook states that GitHub Issues is disabled and names the planned integration record.
- [ ] Both active Gerrit votes and current carry or reset behavior match deployed configuration.
- [ ] Submit guidance reflects Rebase If Necessary.
- [ ] Gerrit-only merging and rollback procedures remain intact.
- [ ] Only the three approved Markdown files change.
- [ ] Focused documentation, ADR, link, and whitespace checks pass. The full local test suite is skipped.
data.title: Align GitHub mirror and Gerrit gate runbooks
